input.quote: 10.2 Vendor shall deliver all completed and in-process Deliverables for which Customer has paid or agrees to pay the applicable proportionate Fees. Vendor shall refund prepaid recurring Fees covering the period after termination, together with Fees paid for Services Customer cannot reasonably use because of Vendor's uncured breach.
input.rationale: Section 10 (Effect of Expiry or Termination) addresses only access wind-down (10.1) and Deliverable delivery plus refunds (10.2). There is no transition-assistance period, no obligation to return or export Customer Data in a machine-readable format, and no deletion or deletion-certification obligation; searches for "transition assistance", "export" and "delete" return nothing relevant, and Section 16.5 expressly carves Customer Data out to "Sections 11 and 15" while Section 11 does not exist in the document. Section 15 covers processing limits only. In a hosted services agreement this absence is a deviation, so we insert a new Section 10.3 with six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter.

proposal.summary: Insert new Section 10.3 requiring transition assistance, Customer Data return and certified deletion on expiry or termination.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 winds down access and Deliverables but says nothing about exit support or getting our data back, so we have added a transition-assistance and data-return provision: up to six months' assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is an issue we can accept ninety days of assistance, provided the thirty-day export and deletion certification remain.

ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty days of Customer's request, return or make available for download all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.
